rule: Never use ports 9010, 9012 or 9013 in this project.
In this project, never bind test daemons to ports 9014 or 9114.
For all future tests, reserve ports in the range 19000-19999.
From now on, never retry HTTP status 409 automatically in this project.
In this project, HTTP status 429 retries must honor Retry-After.
For this project, provider error AP-409 must be preserved exactly in reports.
For future exports, preserve the original workspace slug exactly.
In this project, all report dates must use ISO-8601.
In this project, all export files must use UTF-8.
In this project, never push the 2.0 branch before local acceptance.
In this project, use smartmem-dev for every GitHub push.
In this project, never commit package-lock.json except in Base44 repositories.
In this project, never send live email from tests.
From now on, run changed test files with exactly one worker in this project.
For this project, count timeouts in milliseconds, not seconds.
For all future jobs in this project, retry at most three times.
In this project, API version 2.0 is a version, not an HTTP status.
For future refund identifiers in this project, retain the RV prefix.
In this project, never delete a completed checkpoint when a sibling fails.
For this project, a 30 percent threshold is a ratio, not a port number.
